SELECT c.id, c.picture_url, c.txt, c.create_time, f.`name` AS fy_name, s.user_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM check_in_like cl WHERE cl.checkin_id = c.id) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM check_in_comment cc WHERE cc.checkin_id = c.id) AS comment_count FROM check_in AS c INNER JOIN fyinfo AS f ON c.fy_id = f.id INNER JOIN sys_user AS s ON c.user_id = s.user_id
WHERE c.user_id = #{userId}
